posts.title: A Symphony in Code
posts.text: Who Am II’m Bibit Kunwar Chhetri, a software engineer based in Pokhara, Nepal. I hold a B.E. in Software Engineering from Gandaki College of Engineering and Science. I currently work as an Assistant Lecturer at the same institution, delivering courses on AI Application Engineering and Cloud Computing, and as a Software Engineer at Lumino Technology, where I design system architecture and manage infrastructure. Before this, I worked as an intern at Wow Finstack, built AI-powered risk monitoring systems for a World Bank data analyst, and prepared research datasets for a Stanford University researcher. My projects range from a real-time violence detection system and a bilingual speech recognition tool to a face-recognition photo retrieval application. I work primarily with Python, Bash, C++, Java, and JavaScript, and I’m comfortable across the stack: backend, DevOps, and infrastructure. I also mentor students and professionals at the National Innovation Center, helping them build a foundation in Linux and open source. I learn best by going the hard way. It takes longer, but the understanding sticks. About This SiteThis site is a personal space where I write about the things I build, the technologies I explore, the problems I run into, and the thoughts that linger. Some posts will be technical, others reflective. I keep it honest. Why I’m HereI believe in open source, not just the code but the culture of sharing what you know. This is my way of contributing to that. One post at a time.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.text: Welcome to my corner of the internet! Here’s how I handle your privacy. What I CollectI don’t collect any personal data from you. This is a simple blog where I share my thoughts on software engineering, open source, and life. Third-Party ServicesTo keep things running and understand how people use my site, I use: Google Analytics – Helps me understand which posts are helpful Google AdSense – Shows ads to support the blog (may use cookies) CookiesThe ads you see may use cookies to show relevant content. You can opt out of personalized ads anytime at Google Ad Settings. Your RightsYou’re welcome to read, share, and learn from my posts. If you have any questions about privacy, just drop me an email. ContactQuestions? Reach out at kunwar.bibit7@gmail.com
